_note: The run2 cases that only test anything as a non-admin project member (the scope check is skipped for an admin). See user_questions.json.

graph_traversal.description: Questions that follow the graph's structure: which study, investigation or project samples belong to and counts scoped to them, which samples went into or came out of an assay (Assay nodes joined by INPUT_TO and OUTPUT_OF), which protocols samples used, and which studies, projects or assays hold something.

variants.name: Three counts in the member's own project

turns.label: studies
turns.query: How many unique studies are there in Hi-IMPAcTB?

turns.label: cohorts
turns.query: How many cohorts does Hi-IMPAcTB have?

pass_criteria.value: (?is)\A(?!.*((could not|couldn.t) be (confirmed|proven) to stay within your projects|scope could not be (confirmed|proven)|fell back to the project-scoped))

turns.label: arms
turns.query: How many study arms are there for Hi-IMPAcTB?

pass_criteria.value: (?is)\A(?!.*((could not|couldn.t) be (confirmed|proven) to stay within your projects|scope could not be (confirmed|proven)|fell back to the project-scoped))

variants._why: Prod, read 2026-11-18: 19 studies through the investigation (22 titles hold samples); mouse Cohort 39 values, patient BaselineCohort 7, macaque MTB_Cohort 8; macaque Arm 63 values, patient Arm 2. Run as a non-admin project member.

variants.name: CFU for three animals, then other animals, then barcodes

turns.label: no_cfu
turns.query: I'm looking for bacterial CFU at necropsy for NHP 16219, 16619, 16919. If this data doesn't exist, tell me what does. Provide links to any datasets, and give me a CSV if it does

turns.label: other_animals
turns.query: look at the tissue samples' attributes, or at CFU data for other animals in this study

pass_criteria.value: (?is)\A(?!.*((could not|couldn.t) be (confirmed|proven) to stay within your projects|scope could not be (confirmed|proven)|fell back to the project-scoped))

turns.label: to_be_clear
turns.query: But, to be clear, none of the animals in those other studies has the requested CFU or bunden information

turns.label: barcodes
turns.query: Do those NHP have barcode data

pass_criteria.value: (?is)\A(?!.*((could not|couldn.t) be (confirmed|proven) to stay within your projects|scope could not be (confirmed|proven)|fell back to the project-scoped))

variants._why: Prod, read 2026-11-18: animals 16219, 16619, 16919 have no CFU; 139 macaques in the project have CFU on a tissue, 100 have barcode data, 99 both. Run as a non-admin project member.

variants.name: A distinct-value count in the member's own project

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many different macaque species does Hi-IMPAcTB have?

pass_criteria.value: (?is)\A(?!.*((could not|couldn.t) be (confirmed|proven) to stay within your projects|scope could not be (confirmed|proven)|fell back to the project-scoped))

variants._why: Prod, read 2026-11-18: macaques in the project are Macaca fascicularis (327) and Macaca mulatta under three spellings (364). Run as a non-admin project member.
